metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 1984 · Police Academy
metas.description: The mayor declares that anyone can enroll in the police academy irrespective of their physical condition or education level, and many misfits descend on the academy, including a young troublemaker who's forced to apply or go to jail.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.8 · 1985 · Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
metas.description: Six Police Academy graduates are assigned to the 16th precinct, and their Captain desperately wants them to clean up the crime ridden neighborhood, but his second in command schemes to become captain himself by sabotaging the rook...

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.4 · 1986 · Police Academy 3: Back in Training
metas.description: After it's announced that one of the two police academies in the state will be closed down, Lassard's alumni return to the school to train new recruits and compete against the other academy.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.0 · 1987 · Police Academy 4: Citizens on Patrol
metas.description: The misfit Police Academy graduates are assigned to train a group of civilian volunteers to fight crime once again plaguing the streets.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.7 · 1988 · Police Academy 5: Assignment: Miami Beach
metas.description: Eric Lassard is about to retire, which Harris plans to exploit to take over his position. In Miami, where Lassard is to be honored, a mix-up leads to an adventure involving diamonds, kidnapping and betrayal.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.5 · 1989 · Police Academy 6: City Under Siege
metas.description: Those bumbling cadets take to the streets when three inept goons successfully orchestrate a metropolitan crime wave.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 3.5 · 1994 · Police Academy: Mission to Moscow
metas.description: The Russian government hires the veterans of the Police Academy (1984) to help deal with the Mafia.
